provider: Greater Melbourne councils (Social Pinpoint engagement sites)

admission_evidence.completeness_rule: For each of 28 councils, read sitemap.xml and classify every same-host two-segment page whose lastmod is inside the lookback window; any unreadable sitemap fails the run, and more than two unreadable pages that are also over 10% of a council's candidates fail it

notes: Facts and links only. News pages on the councils' Social Pinpoint sites are found through each site's sitemap.xml, not the vendor news API, which needs a token. Melens stores the headline, the date shown on the page, the parent project and its suburbs, and the link, and writes its own summary; the council's article text and images are never stored. Daily runs re-read two weeks of sitemap changes because sitemaps lag one or two days. Records accumulate; a later sitemap lastmod orders a revised version. Manningham, Kingston and Nillumbik are not covered.
